Secretary Job at Adefila & Partners




        
    

        
        Adefila & Partners is a leading real estate consultancy firm in Nigeria with a rich history spanning over three decades. The firm, ADEFILA & PARTNERS evolved from the older Partnership of Adefila, Akinsomi, Salako & Partners which was established in April 1985 over 40 years ago headed by the Principal Partner Mr. Thomas Kolawole Adefila who has a cognate experience spanning about 40 years.
     

            
    



The need to refocus and reposition the practice for effectiveness and efficiency in the service delivery in all areas of Real Estate Consultancy to meet the challenges of globalization was the reason the firm ADEFILA & PARTNERS was established in March 2003. It is our belief at ADEFILA & PARTNERS that professional staff must possess finest of character, humane disposition, integrity and transparent honesty.

We are seeking a competent, hardworking and self-motivated individual to join our team in the capacity below:

Job Position: Secretary

Job Location: Nigeria

Requirements


	HND/Bachelor's Degree in Office Technology and Management Office Administration, Secretarial Studies, or a related field.
	Proficient in Microsoft Office Suite (Word, Excel, PowerPoint).
	Strong organizational, multitasking, and communication skills.
	Must be very proficient in English Language.


Method of Application 
Interested and qualified candidates should send their CV to: [email protected] using the Job Position as the subject of the mail.

Office Cleaner / Assistant Job at Excellent Jobs




        
    

        
        Excellent Jobs is a consulting and recruitment firm, dedicated to hiring and managing great talents for its clients.

We are recruiting to fill the position below:

Job Position: Office Cleaner / Assistant 

Job Location: Yaba, Lagos
Employment Type: Full-time

Job Summary 


	We are seeking a dependable and detail-oriented office cleaner/assistant capable of takingcare of our facilities and carry out cleaning and maintenance duties.
	The goal is to keep our building in a clean and orderly condition.


Responsibilities and Duties
     

            
    




	Dusting, sweeping, vacuuming and mopping surfaces in their work area including working areas, Toilets, kitchens and supply closets
	Refilling and restocking cleaning supplies and toiletries (hand wash, toilet paper, paper towels)
	Washing kitchen napkins, floor rags and dusters.
	Empty and clean trash/recycling bins and taking waste to designated collection points
	Ensure health and safety regulations are followed by all staff
	Perform and document routine inspection and maintenance activities
	Maintain office supplies and place restock orders as needed
	Support other departments with administrative tasks as required


Requirements and skills


	High school diploma or equivalent
	1–2 years of office assistant or cleaning experience
	Working knowledge of the English language
	Excellent organization and housekeeping skills
	Working knowledge of health and safety standards in their industry
	Ability to work well under pressure
	must reside in Yaba or close to it environment.
	must be between 26 - 32 years of age.


Method of Application
Interested and qualified candidates should send their CV and a brief cover letter to: [email protected] using the Job Position as the subject of the mail.

  "@context": "https://schema.org",
  "@type": "JobPosting",
  "title": "Accountant",
  "description": "Excellent Jobs is a consulting and recruitment firm, dedicated to hiring and managing great talents for its clients.

We are recruiting to fill the position below:

Job Position: Accountant

Job Location: Yaba, Lagos
Employment Type: Full-time
Reports To: Head of Finance / Chief Finance Officer
Experience required: 10&ndash;12 years of progressive accounting/finance experience with a Registered Finance/investment Company.
Professional Qualification: Chartered Accountant (ICAN) &ndash; mandatory; CBN registration &ndash; an added advantage.

Position Overview


	The Accountant is responsible for maintaining accurate financial records, ensuring compliance with accounting standards, and providing financial analysis to support decision-making.
	The role requires a seasoned professional with strong technical expertise, experience in managing complex accounting functions, and the ability to align financial practices with regulatory requirements.
	This position plays a critical role in statutory compliance, internal controls, reporting, and supporting strategic financial initiatives.


Key Responsibilities


	Prepare and maintain accurate general ledger accounts and financial statements
	Ensure timely preparation of monthly, quarterly, and annual financial reports.
	Comply with IFRS and other applicable accounting standards.
	Support consolidation of financial results across departments or subsidiaries.
	Ensure compliance with CBN, FIRS, and other regulatory requirements.
	Liaise with external and internal auditors, providing necessary documentation and explanations.
	File tax returns, statutory remittances, and other regulatory reports on time.

	Prepare and maintain accurate general ledger accounts and financial statements
	Ensure timely preparation of monthly, quarterly, and annual financial reports.

	Prepare daily, weekly and monthly treasury accounts.
	Manage loan portfolio.
	Prepare and present monthly management account.

	Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, or related field.

	Excellent knowledge of accounting principles and standards.

	High attention to detail, accuracy, and integrity.
	Proficiency in accounting/ERP software, QuickBooks, Sage-50 and Microsoft Excel.
	Strong communication and interpersonal skills.

	Very proficient in the use of Bankone Accounting Software.
